English: Mudbrick Hut
A simple, hastily constructed mudbrick shelter, offering protection from the elements for the first arrivals on the savanna.
Wattle Shelter
A larger, sturdier structure using woven wattle and mud, suitable for growing families and small livestock.
Courtyard Pavilion
An open pavilion with a central courtyard, encouraging gatherings and communal meals under the stars.
Thatched Room
Private sleeping quarters with thick thatched roofing, providing comfort for elders and honored guests.
Fenced Yard
A protective fence of woven branches encircles the compound, allowing for livestock and added security.
Guarded Pavilion
A watchful guard post and reinforced pavilion, signifying increasing wealth and status.
Family Hall
A large earthen hall for the extended family, featuring communal fires and decorative art.
Community Room
A central gathering chamber for clan councils and feasts, adorned with clan totems and emblems.
Chiefs Chamber
A lavish suite for the clan chief, with secure storage for treasures and council rooms for key advisors.
West African Compound
A grand, walled compound representing the zenith of West African nomadic settlement, boasting vibrant culture, unity, and security for generations.
